title: Loom method graph manifest and run trace, version 1
description: Client data contracts composed with existing native GraphPacket operations. This schema validates shape and SHA-256 representation; native graph validation and the caller must verify references, real provenance edges, exact captured bytes, hash equality and effective settings. Declared names never select or implement execution mechanisms.

sha256.description: Canonical lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256. The fixed representation is not an operation or resource limit.

entityId.description: Caller-supplied native entity ID. Native packet validation establishes existence and identity; no domain name registry is defined here.

nullableEntityId.description: An optional role may be absent or explicitly null when inapplicable or unknown; clients must not fabricate an entity.

kinds.description: Standard semantic roles are keys, not a closed entity-kind vocabulary. Every value, including values under additional caller roles, is arbitrary client data.

predicates.description: Client predicate strings for actual native Claims; additional relation roles are unrestricted strings.

bindings.description: Client binding map. Only method identity, exact method version and concrete run are universal. Prompt/model/recipe/preset/combination/compiler roles may be omitted or null when inapplicable or unknown. Additional methods or versions may supply additional bindings; the schema does not cap their number.

definitionHashes.description: Client hash map with a required immutable method-version hash. Other definition roles may be absent or null when inapplicable or unknown. Definitions use the native json::canonical encoder; applicable prompt_bytes covers exact UTF-8 bytes. Equality to the captured bytes is verified outside JSON Schema.

measurements.description: Caller-named numeric measurements with no closed metric vocabulary, count cap, bounds or presets. Unknown or unavailable quantities are null, never invented zero. An empty map records no measurements; measurement_scope identifies the instrumentation scope.

modelOrigin.description: Retained native model-origin fields. Native codec origin semantics still apply; this data schema adds no domain vocabulary or evidence truth assertion.

combinationMember.description: An ordered occurrence identifies exactly one method version or nested combination version. Signed finite weights and arbitrary parameters are data; repeated occurrences and shared subgraphs are retained. Native graph validation and traversal establish kind, definition/hash, active membership edges and acyclicity, without a fixed size or depth limit.

combinationDefinition.description: Exact immutable combination data. Ordered member occurrences, weights, parameter overrides and fusion data participate in the canonical definition hash. Shared or repeated members are not deduplicated.

effectiveCombinationVersion.description: Captured native Entity DTO for an effective combination, created bottom-up for the consumed path occurrence. Native codec validation still checks the full Entity shape; this schema checks only the client definition fields.

resultBinding.description: A captured result binding. Actual native Claims to the run and exact method version are required; a JSON reference alone is not an edge. Compiler-transform edges and preserved model origin apply when those mechanisms contributed to this result. Lexical results need neither invented compiler nor model records.

model_identity_id.description: Prepared model descriptor, or the final observed descriptor when explicitly known. A reported alias does not establish descriptor equivalence; an unknown final descriptor is null.

model_identity_basis.description: Caller-captured basis for the requested or observed descriptor, as arbitrary JSON data. It does not establish model equivalence or content truth.

model.description: Prepared request model; after model result binding, the one distinct observed result-origin model, or null for differing or unknown observations. requested_model preserves the request value.

requested_model.description: Immutable prepared request control. A later reported alias never rewrites the requested model, effective recipe or definition hash.

effective_parameters.description: Exact effective client parameters as arbitrary JSON data, including nested objects, arrays, numbers, booleans and null. The schema assigns no parameter names, ranges, counts or preset values.

effective_combination_versions.description: Optional exact effective combination DTOs in bottom-up construction order. selection_path preserves original resolved occurrence identities; final combination binding identifies the effective root.

user_overrides.description: Captured caller overlays or one-call changes as arbitrary JSON data; the effective result is separately recorded in effective_parameters.

response_hash_scope.description: For compiled model results, response_sha256 covers the exact compiler input, independently of transport wire bytes and rendered response text. Unknown or differing input hashes remain null.

methodRunTrace.description: Concrete provenance and instrumentation trace, not an execution request. Its universal minimum identifies method, version, run, effective parameters and input hash (null explicitly means unavailable). All model/prompt/recipe/preset/combination/compiler fields are optional and nullable; declared values retain their native types. Prepared traces need no projected output. Projected model traces preserve applicable result/model/compiler provenance without changing graph-reply host fields.

definition_records.description: Exact caller definition values captured alongside their hashes. Native entities and supporting Observations retain these values; this envelope adds no closed role or parameter vocabulary.

methodGraph.description: Versioned client manifest for ordinary native Entity/Claim/Observation records and diffs. Method identity, immutable method version, concrete run, model content and compiler transformation retain distinct roles.
